summary: Frontend-only verification of AMASS PropTech landing page across mobile (390x844) and desktop (1920x800) viewports. All 10 requested checks PASSED. No horizontal overflow at any scroll depth on either viewport. Hero renders required copy 'Discover Africa's Properties Like Never Before' with full-width stacked CTAs. MobileApp section correctly shows only phone-property on mobile (phone-map and phone-ai-assistant have display:none) and all three phones on desktop. Africa coverage strip lists Lagos, Abuja, Accra, Nairobi, Kigali, Cape Town, Kampala, Dar es Salaam, Dakar, Addis Ababa, Johannesburg, Kumasi, etc. Lead form dialog opens from hero-getapp-btn, submits successfully and shows lead-form-success. Newsletter footer shows 'Subscribed! Welcome to AMASS.' toast on submit. Theme toggle correctly adds/removes 'dark' class on html. FAQ accordion trigger 0 opens (data-state=open).

issues: Non-blocking React warning: 'Invalid DOM property fetchpriority. Did you mean fetchPriority?' appears twice on load. Likely from an attribute — should use camelCase fetchPriority in JSX.

action_items: Minor: fix fetchpriority -> fetchPriority JSX attribute to silence React DOM property warning (search Hero.jsx / Logo.jsx / any ).
critical_code_review_comments: framer-motion whileInView animations on the MobileApp section make elements 'not stable' for Playwright's scroll_into_view_if_needed — future tests should scroll via JS (element.scrollIntoView) rather than Playwright's built-in scroll for animated sections.
seed_data_creation: One lead submitted via UI (Test User / test@example.com) and one newsletter subscription (nltest@example.com) during E2E verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend already 100% (iteration_1). Frontend fully functional at mobile 390x844 and desktop 1920x800. Only remaining nit is a React fetchpriority casing warning in console. When testing MobileApp phones, use page.evaluate scrollIntoView instead of Playwright scroll_into_view_if_needed because framer-motion whileInView keeps elements 'not stable'. Mobile hides phone-map and phone-ai-assistant via display:none (Tailwind hidden sm:block) — verify via getComputedStyle, not isVisible timing.
